sentences.text: Axel Dumas, born 3 July 1970 in Neuilly-sur-Seine, is a sixth-generation member of the founding family of Hermes International and a direct descendant of Emile-Maurice Hermes.

He holds a degree from the Institut d'etudes politiques de Paris and attended Harvard Business School, holds a bachelor's degree in philosophy and a master's in business law, and began his career at BNP Paribas in China from 1995 to 1997 and then in the United States from 1999 to 2003.
